To determine the number of countries classified as **"lower-middle income"** for the year 2020, we analyze the provided query results. The query attempts to group countries by their economic classification and filter them based on a specific year.

The corrected SQL query includes grouping by "lower middle" and applying a filter for the year value being greater than or equal to 2020:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) as num_countries FROM Countries 
GROUP BY [income_level] 
WHERE year >= 2020;
```

This query will return the total number of countries in the **"lower-middle income"** group starting from the year 2020.
